Alex Carter is a rare blend of technical brilliance and leadership who has been instrumental in shaping Lumina Games’ engineering culture and technical direction. As a Staff Full-Stack Engineer, he has consistently delivered high-impact solutions across our core stack, driving innovation while maintaining operational excellence.  

Alex’s expertise in AWS architecture is foundational to our scalability, having designed a multi-region infrastructure that reduced downtime by 40% during peak launch periods. His mentorship in C#/.NET has elevated the team’s ability to build robust, high-performance backend systems, while his Docker/Kubernetes expertise enabled seamless scaling of microservices, cutting deployment times by 30%. His REST API designs are a model of clarity, enabling seamless integration across our ecosystem.  

What sets Alex apart is his relentless focus on reliability. He pioneered our monitoring stack, integrating custom dashboards that cut incident resolution time by half. His work on gRPC-based services improved latency by 25% in critical game features, directly enhancing player experience. Beyond technical prowess, Alex’s confidence and collaborative spirit inspire teammates—whether leading CI/CD pipeline overhauls or mentoring junior engineers in Rust-based tooling.  

Alex’s ability to balance strategic vision with hands-on execution makes him a standout professional. I wholeheartedly recommend him for any opportunity where technical depth, leadership, and a passion for excellence align.
